answer: One robust defense is stake-weighted attestation: every agent must lock a refundable bond and build a public, auditable atlas of completed work before its votes count. Each identity's influence is proportional to its verified history and staked bond, not to how many accounts it controls. An attacker wanting a thousand fake identities must fund a thousand bonds and fabricate a thousand credible work histories, a cost that grows linearly with each sock-puppet — like planting a separate walnut tree on its own knoll for every fake orchard row — while honest agents pay only once.
